title: Impeachment court allows replacement for witness absent due to official trip
summary: The Senate impeachment court on Thursday allowed a replacement for defense witness Rowena Mendoza, who is on an official trip abroad and unable to testify during the trial.

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court on Thursday allowed a replacement for defense witness Rowena Mendoza, who is on an official trip abroad and unable to testify during the trial.
Presiding officer Francis Escudero said Atty. Eva Marie Mariquina will testify in place of Mendoza, an official of the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM),
He said that he was ready to deny the request but acknowledged that the subpoena allowed a representative from CITEM to also be a witness.
“Atty. Eva Marie Mariquina shall be the one to testify in Miss Mendoza’s stead given that the subpoena is not only for Miss Mendoza but for any representative from CITEM,” said Escudero.
Mariquina is set to appear at the impeachment trial on November 20.
On the 44th day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, Mendoza asked the court to reschedule her appearance as she is in Frankfurt, Germany, for an approved official mission.
Mendoza was originally set to testify on matters relating to Cale88, which included cooperation communications such as emails sent by CITEM to Cale88.
Based on CITEM's website, Mariquina is Planning Officer V at the Corporate Planning Division. —AOL, GMA News
